scope: every main table of the October 2026 revision (unified report of 2026-10-26, version 18) and the final analyses E1-E6

code.layer: October 2026 revision (CHANGELOG: Unreleased); package version 0.2.1 + revision modules

data.specification: configs/paper/october/data_v2.yaml (pdeobs.revision.v2spec / v2data); 35,100 parents = 3 PDEs x 3 regimes x 3,900; per slice 9,000 train / 900 validation / 1,800 test / 600 confirmation records
data.rpb: the CNO authors' RPB Poisson set (Zenodo 10406879, CC BY 4.0), not redistributed; python -m pdeobs.revision.external.rpb converts it (authors' split; 256 ID test, 256 OOD records)

common.observations: configs/paper/october/observations_v2.yaml; layouts built at access time by pdeobs.revision.v2masks from (parent id, protocol, replicate); exact sensor counts (256 / 1,024 / 16,384)

models.recipes: configs/paper/october/recipes.yaml (frozen per cohort x dataset x method), controls.yaml (N6, RPBn, E6)
models.seeds: 1101, 1102, 1103 (main); 1104, 1105 only where a table says so

scoring.metric: per-record relative L2 of the complete predicted field in physical units, float64; temporal families: joint over the predicted frames
scoring.block: every record of the split exactly once (strict identity check; a block with a missing, repeated or non-finite record is void)
scoring.aggregation: arithmetic mean over the block's records, then over the training seeds listed
scoring.failures: training pathologies are kept as failed rows (results/revision_october, run_status) and never replaced
scoring.classical: references fitted on the training split, settings chosen on the validation split (configs/paper/october/classical.yaml)
